sourceTitle: Best Pizza Sauce Recipe for a Chicago Deep Dish
sourceText:
Best Pizza Sauce Recipe for a Chicago Deep Dish
By: Ben Myhre
Published: Thursday, January 18, 2018 - 11:55am

Ingredients




1 Can Cento crushed tomatoes, 28 oz
2 Cloves of garlic
Salt, to taste
For Dried seasoning:
1 Teaspoon dried Italian seasoning

Preparation

1 Open can and strain tomatoes 2 In large bowl, add rest of ingredients 3 Use on Chicago Deep Dish Pizza

About

The Chicago Deep Dish pizza does not need much, but you can find out what it does need here. This is a simple and tasty recipe.
